name: openjudge-distillation-receipts
description: Reproducible blind-eval audit trail for the OpenJudge skill distillation performed by skill-anything v2 harness. Includes per-iteration summaries, blind-mapping (de-blinded for public inspection), grader scores, and OSR digests. Publish reason: scientific transparency — anyone can inspect the evidence behind the Skill's claimed quality.
honest_caveats: iter-2 is the KEPT state; iter-3 (composite 0.7792) was a regression and is NOT published.
trajectory_degraded=true at iter-2: all 12 tasks had trajectoryAvailable=false (runners did not emit tool-call counts in the Super-Runner mode this run used). Quality-only signal.
8 pending_surprises from research phase were not resolved in this run — see docs/lessons-learned-openjudge-2026-04-23.md.
grader_ensemble_k=1 (single grader, cost trade-off) rather than the recommended K=3. This is a conscious cost/signal trade; multi-grader rerun is future work.

reproducibility.how_to_re_run: 1. Clone skill-anything and check out the commit in tool.commit_at_distillation. 2. `git clone https://github.com/agentscope-ai/OpenJudge workspace/repo`. 3. Open skill-anything in Claude Code and say: 'Resume distillation from workspace/'. 4. Compare new iter-N/iteration-summary.json against this manifest.
reproducibility.blind_eval_protocol: See references/eval-loop.md for full run/blind/grade/score/improve protocol.
reproducibility.grader_rationale_file: iter-2/grader-scores.json — contains the per-task quality score, feedback, and suggestions used for scoring.
reproducibility.blind_mapping_file: iter-2/blind-mapping.json — the A/B → with-Skill/without-Skill mapping randomized at eval time; published post-eval for inspection.
